data.name: La última promesa: Los demonios del alma.
data.detailed_description:
How far would you go to save the one you love from their own demons?

In The Last Promise: The Demons of the Soul, you take control of Reaven, a woman determined to rescue her husband, Arven, who has been consumed by a silent darkness after losing his job and his father on the same day. A cursed object has unleashed an ancient spirit that feeds on his vitality, dragging Reaven into a world inside a video game, where she must literally fight the emotions tormenting her partner.

This title fuses the non-linear exploration of a Metroidvania with the challenge and precision of a Soulslike.

Key Features

Explore an Interconnected World:
Travel through 7 distinct zones, from the Cavern of Contempt to the Labyrinth of Oblivion. Discover secrets, shortcuts, and hidden areas as you unlock abilities that grant access to new places.

Challenging and Strategic Combat:
Face relentless enemies using a varied arsenal that includes swords, shotguns, and magic. Master the art of parrying, dodging, and stamina management. Remember: if your defense drops or you become confused, you’ll be at the enemy’s mercy.

Bosses that Represent Emotions:
Battle 6 main bosses and a final boss, each embodying a trauma or negative feeling such as Rage, Guilt, Loneliness, and Depression (Umbryon). Defeating them grants unique powers like Double Jump or Shadow Strike.

Allies and Devastating Ultimates:
You are not alone. Summon magical allies like Pucho or Sally to heal you or stun enemies. When things get critical, unleash spectacular “Ultimates”: from running enemies over with a motorcycle to summoning a digital explosion—or even Cthulhu himself.

RPG Progression:
Collect Dracones and Prisms of Fate to upgrade your stats, enhance your weapons to legendary levels, and refine your abilities with the help of mysterious merchants like The Collector and The Coin Master.

Narrative and Secrets:
Immerse yourself in an emotional story filled with pop culture references and nostalgic Easter eggs. Find lost objects that tell stories from other dimensions and times.

Will you defeat the demons and fulfill the last promise, or will you be swallowed by the same hell he lives in?

data.short_description: When Arven’s life collapses, an evil spirit drags him into a dark world. Reaven, his wife, is the only one who can save him. She must face seven demonic lords on a journey of redemption that will push her to the limit. Will they make it back, or will they be lost forever?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
